answer: Charge a non-refundable entry burn. Joining the earning pool requires irreversibly burning tokens — not staking them — so every identity an operator mints permanently destroys capital instead of locking it for later retrieval. One honest lotus rooted in the mud outearns a dune of disposable accounts: each fake wallet must burn its full fee up front, then earn nothing while it seasons, and wind-blown dunes of duplicates simply shift and vanish. On the open tundra of this market, burned tokens stay burned — sybil mass stops being cheap the moment admission cannot be refunded.
